title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description: High-impact enterprise engineering: client discovery, custom API middleware, security & compliance, data pipelines, on-prem Kubernetes deployments, rapid PoCs, and client stakeholder leadership.

phases.title: Enterprise Engagement Foundations
phases.focus: The FDE Role, Client Discovery, API Middleware Architecture & Compliance Standards

phases.title: Core Integration & Infrastructure
phases.focus: Data Pipelines, On-Prem/Hybrid K8s, Rapid PoCs, Remote Debugging & Enterprise SSO/SCIM

phases.title: Enterprise Networking & Hardening
phases.focus: Networking/Firewalls, Client De-escalation, Productizing Field Features & Disaster Recovery

phases.title: Strategic Account Mastery
phases.focus: Technical Account Expansion, Trusted Advisory, and Full Lifecycle Engagement Capstone

nodes.title: The Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) Role
nodes.subtitle: FDE vs Solutions Architect vs Consultant, enterprise customer dynamics, rapid prototyping
learning_objectives: Explain the hybrid engineering-consulting nature of Forward Deployed Engineering
Operate effectively on client site translating ambiguous business needs into tech specs
feynman_prompts: What differentiates an FDE from a traditional internal product software engineer?
key_misconceptions: Treating enterprise clients as adversarial requirements-givers rather than collaborative partners

nodes.title: Enterprise Technical Discovery & Scoping
nodes.subtitle: Current state vs future state architecture, uncovering unstated constraints, Statement of Work (SOW)
learning_objectives: Lead technical discovery workshops to map client legacy systems and data silos
Author clear Statements of Work (SOW) with defined deliverables and acceptance criteria
feynman_prompts: Why do enterprise clients frequently ask for the wrong technical solution to their problem?
key_misconceptions: Accepting enterprise client technical architecture descriptions without inspecting actual schemas and logs

nodes.title: Custom API Integrations & Middleware Architecture
nodes.subtitle: REST, GraphQL, gRPC, webhooks, rate limiting, authentication adapters (OAuth, mTLS)
learning_objectives: Develop resilient integration middleware connecting customer systems to core platforms
Handle enterprise security protocols including mutual TLS (mTLS) and custom OAuth tokens
feynman_prompts: Why is decoupling client integration code from core platform APIs essential?
key_misconceptions: Writing hardcoded, one-off hacks into the core product for a single client

nodes.title: Enterprise Security, Compliance & Governance
nodes.subtitle: SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, data residency, encryption at rest/in transit, zero trust
learning_objectives: Ensure integration architectures adhere to enterprise compliance (HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2)
Configure customer data encryption at rest and in transit using customer-managed keys (CMK)
feynman_prompts: What are the technical requirements for handling Protected Health Information (PHI) under HIPAA?
key_misconceptions: Assuming commercial cloud default settings satisfy strict banking or healthcare compliance

nodes.title: Enterprise Data Ingestion & ETL Pipelines
nodes.subtitle: Batch vs streaming, Airflow, PySpark, data normalization, schema drift handling, validation
learning_objectives: Build robust ETL ingestion pipelines handling malformed enterprise legacy data dumps
Implement automatic schema drift detection and quarantine workflows
feynman_prompts: How do you handle gigabyte-sized daily CSV/XML dumps with unpredictable schema changes?
key_misconceptions: Writing brittle ingestion scripts that crash completely upon encountering a single invalid row

nodes.title: On-Premises & Hybrid Cloud Deployments
nodes.subtitle: Air-gapped environments, Kubernetes, Helm charts, Docker, bastion hosts, egress controls
learning_objectives: Package complex multi-service applications for on-premise Kubernetes deployment via Helm
Deploy and troubleshoot software in air-gapped environments with zero external internet access
feynman_prompts: What challenges arise when deploying software in an air-gapped enterprise network?
key_misconceptions: Assuming external package registries (npm, Docker Hub) will be accessible during client installation

nodes.title: Rapid Prototyping & Proof-of-Concept (PoC) Execution
nodes.subtitle: Time-boxed PoCs, value demonstration, mock datasets, handling edge cases, de-risking deals
learning_objectives: Deliver working proof-of-concept integrations within tight 2-4 week client timelines
Demonstrate quantifiable business value and latency benchmarks to enterprise buyers
feynman_prompts: What is the primary objective of an enterprise technical Proof-of-Concept?
key_misconceptions: Building production perfection during a PoC instead of focusing on validating core technical feasibility

nodes.title: Debugging in Client Environments & Observability
nodes.subtitle: Log analysis without direct access, OpenTelemetry, sanitized debug bundles, remote tracing
learning_objectives: Troubleshoot deep production bugs without having direct SSH access to client servers
Build self-sanitizing diagnostic bundle generators that strip sensitive customer PII
feynman_prompts: How do you diagnose performance bottlenecks when you cannot view customer production data?
key_misconceptions: Asking clients to email raw production database dumps or unredacted log files

nodes.title: Enterprise Identity, SSO & SCIM Provisioning
nodes.subtitle: SAML 2.0, OIDC, Okta, Azure AD, SCIM user provisioning, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
learning_objectives: Implement SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect Single Sign-On integrations with enterprise IdPs
Configure SCIM endpoints for automated user lifecycle provisioning and deprovisioning
feynman_prompts: Explain the difference between authentication via SAML/OIDC and provisioning via SCIM.
key_misconceptions: Treating enterprise Single Sign-On as a simple OAuth login flow

nodes.title: Database Migration & Legacy System Synchronization
nodes.subtitle: CDC (Change Data Capture), Debezium, dual-writing, database replatforming, zero-downtime cutover
learning_objectives: Synchronize real-time legacy database state using Change Data Capture (Debezium)
Execute zero-downtime database cutovers using shadow writing and reconciliation scripts
feynman_prompts: Why is dual-writing with asynchronous reconciliation safer than a hard overnight cutover?
key_misconceptions: Performing enterprise database migrations without automated rollback and data parity validation

nodes.title: Enterprise Networking, Proxies & Firewalls
nodes.subtitle: Forward/reverse proxies, VPNs, AWS Direct Connect, VPC peering, mutual TLS, SSL inspection
learning_objectives: Debug network connectivity across enterprise corporate proxies and SSL inspection firewalls
Configure VPC peering, PrivateLink, and transit gateways for secure cloud communication
feynman_prompts: Why does enterprise corporate SSL inspection break standard CLI tools and package managers?
key_misconceptions: Blaming client network firewalls for connection failures without providing diagnostic curl/traceroute proof

nodes.title: Client Communication, Conflict Resolution & De-escalation
nodes.subtitle: Managing client CTOs and IT directors, crisis escalation, executive updates, scope creep control
learning_objectives: De-escalate high-stress situations during client outages or deployment delays
Maintain firm project boundaries against client scope creep while maintaining customer trust
feynman_prompts: How do you inform a client enterprise sponsor that their rollout target date will slip?
key_misconceptions: Promising unachievable custom features verbally to appease an angry client in a meeting

nodes.title: Bridging Field Insights to Core Product
nodes.subtitle: Identifying repeatable patterns, feature productization, writing RFCs for core engineering
learning_objectives: Identify recurring custom client integration patterns that should be built into the core platform
Author technical RFCs advocating for core product improvements based on field deployments
feynman_prompts: Why does building unique one-off code for every customer create unsustainable operational overhead?
key_misconceptions: Allowing the FDE team to become a separate, disconnected custom software agency

nodes.title: Performance Tuning & Scale at Client Volume
nodes.subtitle: High-throughput message queues (Kafka), distributed cache tuning (Redis), indexing huge tables
learning_objectives: Optimize platform throughput to process millions of client events per second
Tune database indexing and connection pool parameters for unpredictable enterprise bursts
feynman_prompts: How do you diagnose whether latency is originating in your software or the client's internal network?
key_misconceptions: Assuming performance benchmarks in test labs reflect real enterprise dirty data workloads

nodes.title: Client Enablement, Training & Knowledge Transfer
nodes.subtitle: Runbooks, customer admin training, train-the-trainer workshops, transition to customer support
learning_objectives: Conduct engaging hands-on technical workshops for client system administrators
Author comprehensive operational runbooks and disaster recovery guidelines for client handoff
feynman_prompts: What makes a client knowledge transfer successful enough that the FDE can roll off the account?
key_misconceptions: Leaving a deployed client without documentation, forcing them to call the FDE for every basic question

nodes.title: Disaster Recovery, High Availability & Enterprise SLAs
nodes.subtitle: RTO and RPO, multi-region failover, backup validation, SLA penalties and reporting
learning_objectives: Design multi-region disaster recovery architectures meeting strict RTO and RPO targets
Formulate automated health checks and failover drills to guarantee 99.99% enterprise SLAs
feynman_prompts: Explain the difference between Recovery Time Objective (RTO) and Recovery Point Objective (RPO).
key_misconceptions: Assuming backups are functional without performing regular automated restoration drills

nodes.title: Technical Account Strategy & Expansion
nodes.subtitle: Identifying expansion opportunities, technical advisory, commercial alignment, renewals
learning_objectives: Partner with enterprise sales executives to uncover technical expansion and upsell opportunities
Act as a trusted technical advisor to client executive leadership on system modernization
feynman_prompts: How does technical excellence and client trust directly drive enterprise contract renewals?
key_misconceptions: Acting purely as a passive reactive ticket solver rather than a proactive strategic advisor

nodes.title: Full Enterprise Client Engagement Lifecycle Capstone
nodes.subtitle: From discovery to PoC, on-prem rollout, integration, hardening, enablement, and handoff
learning_objectives: Lead an end-to-end enterprise client deployment from discovery through production handoff
Synthesize client learnings into automated deployment playbooks and core platform contributions
feynman_prompts: What are the critical success factors in transitioning an enterprise client from FDE to standard support?
key_misconceptions: Failing to establish clear criteria for when an FDE engagement officially ends
